levels.surface: عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث بن سعد

notes: Ibn Umar is in the scene (his renting and his question are described), so he is not a link (rule 6); the chain runs from Salim to Rafi'
Rafi' speaks and relays his uncle: «عمي» with no name is a relation link
«لقد كنت أعلم» is a second statement of Ibn Umar with no transmitter of its own: noted, not stored as a group
